Parameter.name: mirrorScaleAndOffsetUV
Parameter.description:
XY - scale the texture (horizontal/vertical)
4x2 texture = 0.25/0.5
ZW - offset uv incorporated into scale
4x2 texture = (0,1,2,3)/(0,1) or (0,-1,-2,-3)/(0,-1)

Parameter.name: atlasInvSizeAndOffsetUV
Parameter.description:
XY - invert size of the atlas (horizontal/vertical)
4x2 texture = 0.25/0.5
ZW - offset uv after XY applied (horizontal/vertical)
4x2 texture = (0.0,0.25,0.5,0.75)/(0.0,0.5)

Parameter.name: coatShade
Parameter.description: x brightness, y saturation, w eye gloss

Parameter.name: patternA
Parameter.description: rgb colour of pattern A, a its strength

Parameter.name: dirt
Parameter.description: X - dirt amount 0..1\nYZ - dirtNmap uv scale

Parameter.name: sssColor
Parameter.description: color of the fake subsurface scattering
